title: LDAP: the user lookup returned nothing
plain_english: The LDAP bind and the search both worked; the directory just has no object matching the filter for this User-Name. The search line a few lines up ('Performing search in ... with filter ...') shows exactly what was asked, and that is usually where the mismatch is.

causes.cause: The identity contains a realm or domain prefix that the filter does not strip, so the directory is asked for 'user@corp.example.com' or 'CORP\\user'.
causes.next_check: Compare User-Name with Stripped-User-Name in the debug output; enable the suffix/ntdomain policy or change the filter to use %{Stripped-User-Name}.

causes.cause: Wrong base DN, scope, or filter attribute (uid vs sAMAccountName vs userPrincipalName).
causes.next_check: Copy the base DN and filter from the 'Performing search' line and run the same ldapsearch by hand with the module's bind identity.

causes.cause: The bind identity cannot see the user's OU, so the search legitimately returns nothing.
causes.next_check: Run the ldapsearch as the module's identity, not as an admin; if the admin finds the user and the module identity does not, fix the directory ACLs.
